knowledgeAnswers.rationale: An undefined scope invites disputes over what is included and how extra work is charged. The other options are not the central risk.
The Spam Act requires unsubscribe requests to be acted on within five working days, as ACMA guidance states. Continuing to message, or waiting, is not acceptable.
Checking the margin ensures the discounted job still covers its costs and time. The other options do not follow.

practicalCriteria: Learner writes a follow-up message for a past client that includes a consent check and an unsubscribe option.
Learner designs one package with a defined scope, price, exclusions, frequency and cancellation terms.
Learner checks the package margin against a stated hourly rate and minimum charge, and records the result.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Follow-up message draft with consent note
stopWorkCriteria: Learner sends repeat marketing to a client who has asked to be removed.
